integrity: Original theorem is accompanied by a self-contained analytic proof; finite exact checks support its combinatorial probability identities but cannot certify infinite asymptotic laws.
scientific_limitations: Finite interior threshold sets, fixed \(0\le s<1\), deterministic Zipf weights, and independent homogeneous Poisson rates \(\lambda/N\) only; no uniform process convergence, error rates, aligned discovery Zipf laws, or moving thresholds. Generic weighted empirical limit theory could imply portions of the statements.
title: Gaussian-to-Bernoulli-series transition in Zipf-weighted quorum times
